integrity: The proof derives the automorphism recurrence directly from the published adjacent-level order and separates that new symmetry calculation from the source existence theorem. The finite checker directly verifies the full induced order on exhaustive small widths.
scientific_limitations: The result determines automorphisms, not all endomorphisms or p-morphisms, and applies to the explicit witness family rather than every strictly n-finite variety. An equivalent elementary observation may exist as unindexed folklore.
title: Layer-by-layer symmetry loss makes the strictly \(n\)-finite Heyting witnesses rigid
